title: Your first challenge
description: Nothing is sending the app traffic, and its code fails on every request. Wire it up, fix one line, and watch a run score itself.
instructions: Every challenge works the same way: get the canvas ready, press Run, and the goals score what happens while a script drives the traffic. This one walks you through it.
Drag a connection from Traffic to Web App, then press Run. Every request will fail, and that is the bug you are here to fix.
Once the run starts, select Web App and open its Logs tab to see the error. Fix the line it names, then run again.

events.text: Traffic doubles to twenty requests a second

goals.title: Traffic is connected to Web App
Web App answers every request without an error
goals.hint: The error in Web App's logs names the line in server.js that every request is dying on.
